## Change

Describe the smallest user-visible or trust-boundary change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Normal and `python -O` tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff, formatting, pre-commit, and privacy scan pass.
- [ ] New state transitions have positive and adversarial coverage.
- [ ] The fixed `N=0` and nonauthorization boundary is unchanged or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] No private, restricted, or unlicensed data is included.
